description: OptiBase sizes renewable generation and storage for energy-self-sufficient accommodation used in international disaster response. The POWERBASE project publishes a Python application with a graphical interface for location, transport distances, hourly load profiles and deployment periods. It compares a diesel-generator baseline with photovoltaic generation, wind and batteries, accounting for operational and transport emissions. The tool uses model-pypsa and data-renewables-ninja; its README describes periods of use up to one year. Source code and an archived release are available through GitHub and Zenodo free under GPL-3.0-or-later. Running weather queries requires a Renewables.ninja account and API access. Equipment assumptions are configured in code and therefore require careful adjustment for a new deployment. The software can support emergency-energy capacity planning, but it was not installed or executed during this review.
name: OptiBase-V1.0 - Optimization tool - POWERBASE
